originals.name: Faceted ability-tier nodes
originals.idea: Node shapes whose silhouette carries the ability tier, readable at 375 px (Frankendom HUD, row 14)
originals.keep: Faceted shapes that encode tier; two size steps

originals.name: Boss warning card gated by combat
originals.idea: A warning shows only when it applies (severity match, user off-switch, combat-gated visibility) and clears on the boss's own clear event (Frankendom boss telegraph, rows 13 and 14). Ref: Blizzard_EncounterWarnings/EncounterWarnings.lua lines 10-11, 27-37, 38-66, 68-70
originals.keep: Severity match, user off-switch, combat-gated visibility, clear on the boss event

originals.name: Death recap with avoidable and deadly labels
originals.idea: Each hit in the death recap is flagged avoidable or deadly, with its own icon, so a loss is readable (Frankendom death and respawn, row 17). Ref: Blizzard_DeathRecap/Blizzard_DeathRecap.lua lines 11-19, 220-222
originals.keep: Per-hit flags and one icon per flag

originals.name: Encounter timeline bands
originals.idea: Upcoming boss events in short, medium and long bands with a highlight line (Frankendom boss intro and finisher staging, rows 9 and 13). Ref: Blizzard_EncounterTimeline/EncounterTimelineTrackView.lua line 63, line 80; EncounterTimelineConstants.lua
originals.keep: Three bands and a highlight line

originals.name: Per-category throttled combat audio
originals.idea: Combat audio alerts throttled per category (health, casts, resource), events registered only when a category is on, timers cancelled on refresh, voice per category (Frankendom sound layering and stingers). Ref: Blizzard_CombatAudioAlerts/Blizzard_CombatAudioAlertManager.lua lines 130-168, 169-210, 272
originals.keep: Per-category throttle; register events only when needed; cancel timers on refresh

originals.name: Text-size floor
originals.idea: UI text scale with a minimum floor and font rebuild on change (Frankendom accessibility, hud-ui fold-in). Ref: Blizzard_AccessibilityTemplates/TextSizeManager.lua lines 52-80
originals.keep: A minimum scale and a font rebuild on change

originals.name: Layered map overlay provider
originals.idea: An event layer on the base map as its own data provider (Frankendom zone map UI; no parity row, for Lead to place). Ref: Blizzard_WorldMap/WM_EventOverlayDataProvider.lua (named, read by AU023)
